sanskrit_verse:
विवाहादिविधिः स्त्रीणां यत्र पुंसां च कीर्त्यते
स्त्रीपुंसयोगनामैतद् विवादपदम् उच्यते
transliteration:
vivāhādividhiḥ strīṇāṃ yatra puṃsāṃ ca kīrtyate
strīpuṃsayoganāmaitad vivādapadam ucyate
sph_interpretive_translation: Where the ordinances concerning marriage and related duties of women and men are declared, that conjunction of male and female principles constitutes the field of dispute-resolution.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with cosmic dharma, not gendered roles alone
Causation arises through misalignment of relational dharmic capacity
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by conscious participation in relational harmony
Restoration logic operates through re-establishment of sacred union and mutual integrity
Consciousness alignment supersedes transactional or contractual frameworks
executable_legal_axioms: IF a relational contract involves both male and female parties THEN its dissolution must invoke restorative protocols ensuring energetic completion
IF gendered duty misalignment occurs THEN initiate consciousness-realigning mediation before judicial review
IF marital discord arises THEN assess causal imbalance via pramāṇa-based inquiry into individual and collective sankalpa integrity
IF conflict involves sacred bond THEN resolution shall prioritize reunification over separation
IF any party withdraws awareness from relational commitment THEN automatic invocation of responsibility-assumption protocol
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication involving matrimonial disputes, the threshold of responsibility lies in verifying sankalpa alignment at time of union. Authority flows from ontological clarity of intent, not procedural formality. Restoration precedes judgment; reintegration supersedes decree.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here denotes precise alignment between declared sankalpa and lived reality. Dispute emerges when sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) reveals discontinuity between stated intent and enacted behavior. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of conscious deviation observed. Punishment has no place where correction aligns energy fields back to original harmonics.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate joint sankalpa renewal ceremony under witness of spiritual authority
Assign completion process for unresolved emotional residues affecting relational field
Facilitate capacity restoration through guided inner reconciliation sessions
Establish shared accountability framework based on reciprocal energetic transparency
Activate ancestral lineage healing if generational distortion detected
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this edict establishes the supremacy of relational consciousness over punitive constructs. Justice flows as restoration; truth manifests as unity. So it is decreed.
